subject: HIPAA addendum + KMS/HSM credits — proposed path to close
messages:
From: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@medidatahealth.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Dan Reilly <dan.reilly@medidatahealth.com>, procurement@medidatahealth.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood HIPAA addendum + KMS scopes — follow-up

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal ran the HIPAA addendum you sent (v1) and came back with two asks:

1) We need explicit KMS/HSM obligations and a breakdown of costs if we request dedicated HSM key material (customer-managed).
2) For audit logs, we need evidence of retention configuration options and a one-time export capability for annual audits — would that be additional?

Procurement also asked whether there are any one-time onboarding credits or discounts available if we commit to a 12-month Dedicated plan. Our finance lead (Dan) is trying to close the P.O. this month.

Can you share a clear line-item estimate so we can put it in the request? Also attaching the redlines from our counsel (see attached).

Thanks,
Emma Thomas
Director of Security & Compliance
Medidata Health

Attachment: Medidata_HIPAA_redlines.pdf (pdf stub)

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@medidatahealth.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood HIPAA addendum + KMS scopes — follow-up

Emma — thanks for the clear asks and the redlines. I reviewed with Legal and Product. Quick summary up top, full details below:

- KMS/HSM: We support both Redwood-managed and customer-managed keys. Customer-managed (HSM-backed) is an add-on: one-time provisioning fee + monthly per-key vault fee. I attached our pricing matrix (KMS_HSM_pricing_matrix.xlsx).
- Audit logs: retention tiers (30/365/indefinite) are configurable. Annual export is available as a standard runbook (no extra engineering fee for the export itself). Very long-term retention tiers (indefinite) carry storage costs.
- Onboarding credits: for 12-month Dedicated commitments we can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first 3 months of committed spend, or a flat $25k credit for deals over $500k ARR. We can flex if procurement needs a different structure.

Next steps I propose:
1) We (Redwood) mark up your redlines and return HIPAA_Addendum_v2.pdf for legal sign-off. (PR: Prioym?)
2) I’ll send a line-item commercial summary (KMS/HSM provisioning + monthly fees + audit retention cost scenarios) for Dan to drop into PO.
3) If that looks good, we queue a short SOW for the HSM onboarding window and lock a target start date.

If you want a single number off the bat, a sample scoped configuration (customer-managed HSM for 2 key vaults + 365d audit retention + Dedicated small pool) is roughly $86k initial + $12k/mo. I’ll refine with accounting and iterate.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HIPAA_Addendum_v2.pdf (pdf stub)

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood HIPAA addendum + KMS scopes — internal pricing options

Quick internal —

I reviewed the sample numbers. A couple of negotiating levers to keep in mind:
- Give them onboarding credit as % of committed spend rather than flat $25k to avoid a big haircut on smaller commit sizes. Recommend 12% of first 3 months for this account given they are high-touch and likely to expand.
- For HSM provisioning: waive the one-time provisioning fee if they sign a 12-month upfront commit and include a 6-month pilot clause; otherwise keep the fee.
- Offer a 3-month charge-delay for the HSM key-vault fee during onboarding as a courtesy.

Marissa — can you draft the commercial summary (line items + two pricing scenarios: standard and aggressive discount) so we can share with Emma/Dan tomorrow? Priyom — legal to mark up HIPAA_Addendum_v2 and confirm the HSM-specific SLA language.

Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@medidatahealth.com>, Dan Reilly <dan.reilly@medidatahealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial summary: HIPAA + KMS/HSM pricing scenarios (DL-43321)

Emma / Dan — attaching the line-item summary and two scenarios we discussed. High-level:

Scenario A — Standard
- Dedicated small pool (committed): $60,000 initial provisioning (includes 2-week onboarding support)
- Customer-managed HSM: $20,000 one-time provisioning + $3,500/month per vault (2 vaults)
- Audit logs (365d retention): $1,500/month storage and export tooling
- Onboarding credit: 10% of first 3 months => $6,000 credit applied to month 2
- Estimated first-year net: ~$420k

Scenario B — Accelerated (procurement-friendly)
- Dedicated small pool (committed): $60,000 initial provisioning
- Customer-managed HSM: waive one-time provisioning fee if 12-month upfront commit; $3,000/month per vault during first 3 months (then $3,500/mo)
- Audit logs (365d): $1,200/month
- Onboarding credit: 12% of first 3 months => $7,200 credit applied to earliest invoice
- Additional courtesy: 3-month delay on vault monthly charges during onboarding
- Estimated first-year net: ~$372k

We strongly prefer Scenario B if Medidata can commit to 12 months and sign the HIPAA addendum this month. Attached: KMS_HSM_pricing_matrix.xlsx and HIPAA_Addendum_v2.pdf (marked).

Next step: confirm which scenario Dan prefers and we’ll produce a PO-ready quote and updated DocuSign link.

Thanks — Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: KMS_HSM_pricing_matrix.xlsx (xlsx stub), commercial_summary_DL-43321.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Dan Reilly <dan.reilly@medidatahealth.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, emma.thomas@medidatahealth.com

Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial summary: HIPAA + KMS/HSM pricing scenarios (DL-43321)

Marissa / Team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Scenario B looks workable to finance. Two clarifications before I route to procurement:
1) Can you send a single PO line for "HIPAA Compliance Bundle (incl. 2 HSM vaults)" with the discounted year-1 total? Procurement prefers single-line items for easier processing.
2) Need the DocuSign link for the HIPAA addendum + SOW bundle. If we sign this week we should be able to get P.O. approved by next Tue.

If you can get the PO-ready quote and DocuSign link in the next 24 hours we will proceed.

—Dan
CFO, Medidata Health
